headline: Executive order addresses four organizations created alongside NAFTA, including the Commission for Environmental Cooperation and the North American Development Bank.
what_it_does: This order deals with four organizations set up by the US, Canada, and Mexico around the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA). They cover environmental cooperation, labor cooperation, environmental projects along the US-Mexico border, and a development bank. Orders like this usually give such groups legal protections under US law, such as protection from certain lawsuits and taxes. The title alone does not spell out the exact details.

who_it_affects.how: They likely receive special legal status, privileges, or protections when operating in the United States.

who_it_affects.group: Employees and officials of these organizations
who_it_affects.how: They may receive certain legal protections tied to their official work.
